_comment: The metaesthetics-verify ecosystem, as start_verifier.py creates it the first time it
runs. Data rather than code so the shape of the verifier's fleet can be corrected
without editing a launcher — and so the three roles here are visibly the same three
roles Bugmaster's device gate names in a job's `qaRole`.
`from_project` is a folder under app/projects (the QA Master's notebook, which the
verifier does not otherwise touch). The listed fields are copied out of that project's
meta.json at seed time, so the verifier tests the same package and platform the real
suite does rather than a frozen copy that drifts. device_serial is never copied: the
iOS roles must not inherit the real iPad's pin, and the Android role gets its own.
patient-android is pinned to emulator-5554 on purpose. Most fixes are screen logic and
the AVD is always there; jobs that need real hardware are marked needsRealDevice by
Bugmaster and wait for the phone instead. See docs/VERIFIER.md.
